violated_contract: Replacing a live session or socket must not drop the predecessor until the successor is ready to serve the same user-facing path. A gap where neither is usable forces the first requests onto a degraded fallback even though a working session existed moments earlier.
canonical_prevention: Rebuild make-before-break: keep the live session as the route until the incoming session is connected, then swap on idle. Fence each session's callbacks to that instance so a retired socket's late close/error cannot mutate the successor. Behavioral tests assert isWarm stays true during the successor mint, a PTT begin during rebuild hits the predecessor, an incoming error leaves the live session up, and a retired close after swap does not drop the successor.
